Feature: Port iOS app enhancements to web app

Major improvements ported from iOS Loomiverse app:

1. Author Styles Integration \(25+ styles\)
   - Added src/data/authorStyles.js module
   - Imports AuthorStyles.json from iOS app
   - Random author selection per genre
   - Author style injected into chapter generation prompts

2. Expanded Genre System \(6 → 26 genres\)
   - Fantasy variants: Epic Fantasy, Dark Fantasy
   - Sci-Fi variants: Classic, Cyberpunk, 70s Sci-Fi
   - Mystery/Thriller: Mystery, Thriller, Noir, Crime
   - Romance: Classic, Romantic Comedy
   - Horror: Classic, Gothic
   - Plus: Young Adult, Historical, Dystopian, Paranormal,
     Adventure, Action, Western, Satire, Magic Realism,
     Biography, Comedy, Graphic Novel
   - Each genre has specific story formula and era settings

3. Story Outline Generation \(NEW\)
   - Generates 10-point story outline before Chapter 1
   - Uses genre formula as structural guide
   - Outline tracked in StoryBible and injected into prompts
   - Better narrative structure and chapter continuity

4. Enhanced StoryBible
   - Added authorStyle, storyOutline, genreFormula fields
   - formatOutlineContext\(\) shows current position
   - formatAuthorStyleContext\(\) for AI guidance
   - getCurrentPlotPoint\(\) for chapter-specific guidance

5. Improved Genre Selection UI
   - Organized into 5 categories
   - Scrollable layout for 26 genres
   - Responsive grid \(2-4 columns\)
